note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), nominations Friday 5 January, poll Monday 15 January 1934. Thirteen members were returned unopposed (ten Unionists, two Nationalists and a Labour member); Dock and Pottinger were contested, and Labour took Dock (Belfast News-Letter, 6 and 16 January 1934). State of the Council afterwards: Unionists 45, Nationalists 7, Labour 5, Independents 3. Labour gain from the retiring Unionist, Senator Cunningham. The valid-vote figure is unclear on the page image (the two votes sum to 4,734).
